entries.spell_fling_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Max Health damage is capped at 300 against minions and jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_nocturneshroudofdarkness_tooltipex: <rules>This Ability will remain active during <spellName>Paranoia's</spellName> flight.</rules>
entries.spell_luluw_summary: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
entries.spell_twitchexpunge_summary: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
entries.spell_katarinapassive_summary:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.
entries.spell_twitchhideinshadows_tooltip:
Twitch Camouflages and gains @MoveSpeedMod@% Move Speed for @StealthDuration@ seconds. The Move Speed increases to @HiddenSpeed@% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains @AttackSpeedMod*100@% Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.
entries.spell_dravenspinning_tooltip:
Draven readies a Spinning Axe, causing his next Attack to deal an additional @TotalDamage@ physical damage and ricochet into the air. If Draven catches it, he readies another Spinning Axe.

Draven can hold two Spinning Axes at once.
entries.spell_sivire_summary: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.
entries.spell_sivirpassive_summary: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
entries.spell_dravenrcast_tooltipextendedbelowli:
Damage falloff resets after reversing direction.
Whirling Executes from League of Draven: @f1@
entries.spell_luluq_tooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*-100@%, decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Enemies take @BonusMissileDamage@ magic damage from additional bolts.
entries.spell_velkoze_summary: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.
entries.spell_velkozr_summary: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.
entries.spell_trundlediseaseoverseer_tooltip: When an enemy dies near Trundle, he restores <healing>@RegenPercent@ of its max Health</healing>.
entries.spell_riftwalk_summary: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.
entries.spell_singedp_tooltip: Singed drafts off of nearby allied or enemy champions, gaining <speed>@MSPercent*100@% Move Speed</speed> for @MSDuration@ seconds. This effect has an @PerTargetCD@ second Cooldown per champion.
entries.spell_lulur_tooltip: Lulu enlarges an ally, <status>Knocking Up</status> surrounding enemies for @KnockbackDuration@ second. The enlarged ally gains <healing>@TotalBonusHealth@ max Health</healing> and <status>Slows</status> surrounding enemies by @SlowPercent@% for @BuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_velkozq_summary: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.
entries.spell_insanitypotion_summary: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
entries.spell_karthusfallenone_tooltip: Karthus channels for 3 seconds, then deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemy champions, regardless of distance.
entries.spell_velkozr_tooltip:
Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of @TotalDamage@ magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by @Effect3Amount@%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by {{Spell_VelkozPassive_Name}}.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.
entries.spell_yoneq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This Ability acts like an Attack: it can critically strike for <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageCrit@ physical damage</physicalDamage>, it applies %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-hit</OnHit> effects and lifesteal to the first enemy struck, is interruptible by crowd control, and its cooldown and cast time are reduced with <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.</rules>
entries.spell_teemor_summary: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.
entries.spell_olafrecklessstrike_summary: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.
entries.spell_chronoshift_tooltipextendedbelowli: <rules>Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.</rules>
entries.spell_teemow_summary: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.
entries.spell_voidstone_tooltip: Kassadin takes @DamageReductionPercent*100@% reduced magic damage and is Ghosted.
entries.spell_teemoq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Minions and jungle monsters are <status>Blinded</status> for @MinionMonsterDurationMod*100@% longer.</rules>
entries.spell_xinzhaop_summary: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.
entries.spell_dravenpassive_tooltip:
Draven gains @StackGain@ stack whenever he kills a non-champion unit or turret, catches a Spinning Axe.

Draven gains @PassiveGoldBase@ gold plus @PassiveGoldPerStack@ additional gold per stack upon killing a champion. Draven loses @PercentOfStacksLost@% of stacks upon death.

Total Gold Earned: @DravenPassiveGoldEarned@
Highest Reward: @DravenPassiveHighestBounty@
entries.spell_xinzhaoq_tooltip: Xin Zhao's next 3 Attacks deal an additional @BonusDamage@ physical damage and reduces his other Ability's Cooldowns by 1 second. The third Attack also Knocks Up for @KnockUpDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_olafragnarok_summary: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.
entries.spell_warwickw_summary: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.
entries.spell_karthuswallofpain_tooltip: Karthus creates a wall that lasts for @WallDuration@ seconds. Enemies that pass through lose <scaleMR>@MagicResistShred@% Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @DebuffDuration@ seconds and are <status>Slowed</status> by @SlowPercent@% decaying over the duration.
entries.spell_trundlepain_tooltip: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalPercentHPDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and stealing <scaleArmor>@ArmorMRShred*100@% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> over @ActualDurationOfDrainBuff@ seconds.
entries.spell_forcepulse_summary: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.
entries.spell_xinzhaoe_summary: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.
entries.game_character_passivedescription_olaf: Olaf gains up to <attackSpeed>@MaxAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and @MaxLifeSteal@ Life Steal, based on his missing Health.
entries.spell_nocturnee_summary: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.
entries.spell_nocturnep_tooltipextended:
Every @Cooldown@ seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for @TotalDamageNoCrit@ physical damage and restores @TotalHealing@ Health per target hit.

Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @AACDR@ second, increased to @AAChampMonsterCDR@ against champions and jungle monsters.

Umbra Blades deals @DamageMinionMod*100@% less damage to minions and heals @HealMinionMod*100@% less from lane minions.
entries.spell_karthusdeathdefied_tooltip: When Karthus dies he can use his Abilities for free for @PassiveDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_warwickw_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies.</rules>
entries.spell_insanitypotion_tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him @StatAmount@ <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor>, <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, <speed>Move Speed</speed>, <healing>Health Regen</healing>, and <scaleMana>Mana Regen</scaleMana> for @Duration@ seconds. During this effect, Singed's <spellName>Poison Trail</spellName> also applies @GrievousAmount*100@% Grievous Wounds for @GrievousDuration@ second.
entries.spell_sivirr_tooltip:
Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them @MaxMS*100@% Move Speed for @UltDuration@ seconds.

Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by @AttackCooldownRefund@ seconds.

Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.
entries.spell_yonepassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_YonePassive_Tooltip}}

Intent is calculated after other Critical Strike Chance modifying effects.
Current bonus: @f2@% Critical Strike Chance, @f3@ Bonus Attack Damage.
entries.spell_zileanw_summary: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.
entries.spell_sivirq_summary: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
entries.spell_sivirw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Bounces will prioritize new targets before returning to targets that have already been struck. Can only hit each target a maximum of two times.
Bounces deal @MinionDamageMod*100@% damage to minions.
This ability executes low Health minions.
entries.spell_netherblade_summary: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.
entries.spell_yonew_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Shield increased by @FirstChampShieldMultiplier*100@% for the first champion hit and @SecondChampShieldMultiplier*100@% for all subsequent champions.
This abilities cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.
Minimum @MinimumDamageMinions@ total damage against minions.
entries.spell_olaffrenziedstrikes_tooltip: Olaf gains <attackSpeed>@Attackspeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @Duration@ seconds, and <shield>@BaseShield@ plus @ShieldPercMissingHP*100@% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of @MaxShieldCalc@ Shield below @ThresholdForMax*100@% Health)</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_dravenfury_summary: Draven gains increased Move Speed and Attack Speed. The Move Speed bonus decreases rapidly over its duration. Catching a Spinning Axe will refresh the cooldown of Blood Rush.
entries.spell_timewarp_tooltip: Zilean <status>Slows</status> an enemy champion by @SpeedAmount@% or grants an allied champion <speed>@SpeedAmount@% Move Speed</speed> for @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_yonew_summary:
Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe.

Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed.
entries.spell_teemoe_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This poison deals @MonsterMod*100@% damage to jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_poisontrail_summary: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
entries.spell_dravenrcast_summary: Draven hurls two massive axes to deal physical damage to each unit struck. Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and returns to Draven after striking an enemy champion. Draven may also activate this ability while the axes are in flight to cause it to return early. Deals less damage for each unit hit and resets when the axes reverse direction. Executes enemies who have less health than Draven's number of Adoration stacks.
entries.spell_sivirq_tooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@</physicalDamage> to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of @FallOffMinimum*100@%.
entries.spell_dravenspinning_summary: Draven's next attack will deal bonus physical damage. This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once.
entries.spell_xinzhaor_summary: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.
entries.spell_nocturneq_summary: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
entries.spell_warwickr_summary: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.
entries.spell_dravendoubleshot_tooltip: Draven chucks a sideways axe that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>, <status>Knocks Back</status>, and <status>Slows</status> by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_twitchdeadlyvenommarker_summary: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing true damage each second.
entries.spell_karthuslaywastea1_tooltip: Karthus creates a blast of magic, dealing <magicDamage>@QDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. If the blast hits only one enemy, it instead deals <magicDamage>@QSingleTargetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_twitchfullautomatic_tooltipextende: <rules>Using this Ability does not break <keywordStealth>Camouflage</keywordStealth>, but Attacking still does.</rules>
entries.spell_sivire_tooltip: Sivir creates a magical barrier for @SpellShieldDuration@ seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores <healing>@TotalHeal@ health</healing> and triggers Fleet of Foot.
entries.spell_sivirpassive_tooltip: Sivir's Attacks and Abilities grant her a burst of @FlatMS@ Decaying Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds when they damage enemy champions.
entries.spell_sivirw_summary: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
entries.spell_voidstone_summary: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.
entries.spell_trundlecircle_summary: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.
entries.spell_chronoshift_summary: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.
entries.spell_nulllance_summary: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.
entries.spell_warwicke_summary: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.
entries.spell_twitchvenomcask_tooltip:
Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for @Duration@ seconds.

Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by @TotalSlowAmount@% and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.
entries.spell_katarinaw_summary: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> into the air directly above herself.
entries.spell_nocturnew_tooltipsimple:
Passive: Nocturne gains @ActiveAS@% Attack Speed.

Active: Block the next enemy ability that hits him within 1.5 second(s).
entries.spell_dravenfury_tooltip:
Draven becomes Ghosted, gains @Temp_MSMod@% Move Speed decaying over @Temp_MSDuration@ seconds and @Temp_AS@% Attack Speed for @Temp_ASDuration@ seconds.

When Draven catches a Spinning Axe, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.
entries.spell_xinzhaor_tooltip:
Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for @MarkDuration@ seconds.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals @TotalDamage@ plus @PercentCurrentHealthDamage*100@% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies.

Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for @MissileDefenseBaseDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_luluq_summary: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
entries.spell_trundletrollsmash_summary: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.
entries.spell_yonee_tooltip:
Yone enters a spirit form for @ReturnTimer@ seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining @StartingMS*100@% to @MovementSpeed*100@% ramping Move Speed.

When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats @DeathmarkPercent*100@% of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form.

Recast: End spirit form early.
entries.spell_karthusdefile_tooltip:
Passive: When Karthus kills a unit, he restores @ManaRestoreOnKill@ Mana.

Toggle: Karthus creates a necrotic aura, dealing @TotalDPS@ magic damage per second to nearby enemies.
entries.spell_yonepassive_summary: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.
entries.spell_trundlecircle_tooltip: Trundle creates an icy pillar for @PillarDuration@ seconds, briefly <status>Knocking Back</status> enemies directly over it and <status>Slowing</status> nearby enemies by @SlowAmount@%.
entries.spell_riftwalk_tooltip:
Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing @BaseDamage@ magic damage.

Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next @RStackDuration@ seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional @BonusDamage@ magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to @MaxStacks@ times.
entries.spell_twitchfullautomatic_summary: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
entries.spell_karthusdefile_summary: Karthus passively steals energy from his victims, gaining Mana on each kill. Alternatively, Karthus can surround himself in the souls of his prey, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but quickly draining his own Mana.
entries.spell_timewarp_summary: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.
entries.spell_sivire_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This shield blocks both champion and item Abilities.</rules>
entries.spell_karthusdeathdefied_summary: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form that allows him to continue casting spells.
entries.spell_forcepulse_tooltip:
Passive: {{Spell_ForcePulse_Name}}'s Cooldown is reduced by @ReductionPerSpellCast@ second whenever any Ability is used near Kassadin.

Active: Kassadin unleashes a void pulse, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ second.
entries.spell_zileanw_tooltip: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by @CooldownReduction@ seconds.
entries.spell_poisontrail_tooltipextendedbelowli:
Cloud duration: @CloudDuration@ seconds.
Poison duration: @PoisonDuration@ seconds.
Approximate total damage: @ApproximateTotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage.
If a minion would be killed by minion damage while under the effects of Poison Trail, Singed claims the kill credit instead.
entries.spell_megaadhesive_tooltip: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, <status>Grounding</status> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies in the area by @SlowPercent@% for @WDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_katarinaq_summary: Katarina throws a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.
entries.spell_teemoq_summary: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.
entries.spell_warwickq_tooltip:
Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing @BaseBiteDamage@ plus @TargetPercentHPDamage@% max Health magic damage and healing for @LifestealPercent@% of the damage dealt.

Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing.
entries.spell_warwickp_summary: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.
entries.spell_velkozw_tooltip:
Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing @InitialDamage@ magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing @SecondaryDamage@ magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).
entries.spell_karthusfallenone_summary: After channeling for 3 seconds, Karthus deals damage to all enemy champions.
entries.spell_heightenedlearning_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_HeightenedLearning_Tooltip}}

Total awarded: @TotalXP@ Experience.

Experience can't be granted in combat.
entries.spell_yoneq_summary:
Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.
entries.spell_nocturnew_tooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains @ActiveAS@% Attack Speed.

Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to @ActiveAS*2@% Attack Speed for @DoubleASDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_katarinaq_tooltip: Katarina throws a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor>, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the target and @MaxBounces@ nearby enemies. The <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.
entries.spell_fling_tooltip:
Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing @BaseDamage@ plus @MaxHPDamage@% max Health magic damage.

If Singed flings a target into his {{Spell_MegaAdhesive_Name}}, they are Rooted for @RootDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_singedp_summary: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.
entries.buff_teemopassive_summary: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.
entries.spell_katarinaewrapper_summary: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.
entries.spell_lulur_summary: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
entries.spell_warwickr_tooltipextendedbelowline:
This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects 3 distinct times over its duration, and does not Critically Strike.
This Ability Knocks Down enemies.
entries.spell_nocturnep_summary:
Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself.

Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.
entries.spell_chronoshift_tooltip: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for @RDuration@ seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for @ReviveStateDuration@ seconds, then reviving them and restoring <healing>@RTotalHeal@ Health</healing>.
entries.spell_xinzhaoe_tooltip:
Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing @ChargeDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Xin Zhao grants himself @f1@% (%i:scaleAS%%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.

This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.
entries.spell_megaadhesive_summary: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.
entries.buff_teemopassive_tooltip:
If Teemo stands still for @StealthCooldownDuration@ seconds without being damaged, he becomes Invisible until he moves. While in a brush, he can maintain Invisibility while moving.

Upon exiting this Invisibility, Teemo gains @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_poisontrail_tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals <magicDamage>@DamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second.
entries.spell_olafaxethrowcast_summary: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.
entries.spell_trundledesecrate_summary: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.
entries.spell_lulue_tooltip:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for @PixOnAllyDuration@ seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and granting True Sight of them for @PixOnEnemyDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_trundletrollsmash_tooltip: Trundle's next Attack deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and briefly <status>Slows</status> by @SlowAmount*100@%, then Trundle gains <physicalDamage>@BonusAD@ Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for @SapDebuffDuration@ seconds and the enemy loses <physicalDamage>@SappedAD*-1@ Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for the same duration.
entries.spell_teemoe_tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Teemo's Attacks apply poison %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing an additional <magicDamage>@ImpactCalculatedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> plus <magicDamage>@TotalDotDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @PoisonDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_yoneq_tooltip:
Yone thrusts forward, dealing @QDamage@ physical damage.

On hit, grants a stack for @BuffDuration@ seconds. At 2 stacks, this ability causes Yone to dash forward with a wave of wind that Knocks Up for @Q3KnockupDuration@ seconds and deals @QDamage@ physical damage.
entries.spell_olafrecklessstrike_tooltip:
Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing @TotalDamage@ true damage. If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded.

Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.
entries.spell_trundledesecrate_tooltip: Trundle freezes an area for @Duration@ seconds. While inside he gains <speed>@MSBonus*100@% Move Speed</speed>, <attackSpeed>@ASBonus*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, and @HealingBonus*100@% increased healing.
entries.spell_nocturnee_tooltipsimple:
Passive: Gain massively increased Move Speed toward feared enemies.

Active: Damages an enemy over @LeashDuration@ second(s). If this completes, the target is feared for @CCDuration@ second(s).
entries.spell_velkozq_tooltip:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slows by @SlowAmount*100@% decaying over @SlowDuration@ second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores @TooltipManaRefund@ Mana.
entries.spell_heightenedlearning_summary: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.
entries.spell_warwickw_tooltip:
Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining @PassiveMSBonus@% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant @PassiveASBonus@% Attack Speed. These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health.

Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%.
entries.spell_xinzhaoq_summary: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.
entries.spell_katarinapassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_KatarinaPassive_Tooltip}}

Dagger slashes apply On-Hit Effects to champions.
entries.spell_katarinaewrapper_tooltip:
Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for @TotalDamage@ magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range.

Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @DaggerCooldownReduction@ seconds (@TooltipDaggerReduction@). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.
entries.spell_dravendoubleshot_summary: Draven throws his axes, dealing physical damage to targets hit and knocking them aside. Targets hit are slowed.
entries.spell_yonepassive_tooltip:
Steel and Spirit: Yone uses two blades, causing every second Attack to deal @MagicDamageSplit*100@% magic damage.

Intent: Yone's Critical Strike Chance is increased by @CritChanceMultiplier*100@% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to @CurrentCritDamage@. Gain @YoneCritToAD*.01@ Bonus AD for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.
entries.spell_xinzhaoe_tooltipextended:
Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing @ChargeDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Xin Zhao grants himself @f1@% = (@ASMod*100@% +1% per @PermanentASToASRatio@% Permanent %i:scaleAS% +@APToASRatio*10000@% per 100%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.

This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.
entries.spell_nocturneq_tooltipsimple:
Throws a shadow blade, damaging enemeis struck and leaving a Dusk Trail.

Nocturne gains @MoveSpeed@% Move Speed and @BonusTrailAD@ Attack Damage on the trail.
entries.spell_karthuswallofpain_summary: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy. Any enemy units that walk through the screen have their Move Speed and Magic Resist reduced for a period.
entries.spell_dravenrcast_tooltip:
Draven hurls two massive axes that deal @RCalculatedDamage@ physical damage. Upon hitting a champion or Recasting, they reverse direction and return to Draven. The axes deal @RDamageReductionPerHit*100@% less damage for each enemy hit, down to a minimum of @RMinDamagePercent@%.

If {{ Spell_DravenRCast_Name }} would leave an enemy champion with less health than @RPassiveStacksCoefficient*100@% of Draven's current {{Spell_DravenPassive_Name}} stacks (@RPassiveTrueDamage@), he will execute them.
entries.spell_yoner_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>If no enemy champion is struck, Yone will instead blink to maximum range.</rules>
entries.spell_katarinar_tooltip:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals @DamageCalc@ magic damage and @ADDamageCalc@ physical damage, and applies @GrievousAmount*100@% Grievous Wounds for @GrievousDuration@ seconds.

Total over @Duration@ seconds to each enemy: @TotalDamageCalc@ magic damage and @TotalADDamageCalc@ physical damage.
entries.spell_nocturnep_tooltip:
Every @Cooldown@ seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for @TotalDamageNoCrit@ physical damage and restores @TotalHealing@ Health per target hit.

Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @AACDR@ second, increased to @AAChampMonsterCDR@ against champions and jungle monsters.
entries.spell_xinzhaow_summary: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.
entries.spell_netherblade_tooltip:
Passive: Kassadin's Attacks deal an additional @OnHitDamage@ magic damage.

Active: Kassadin charges his blade, causing his next Attack to deal @ActiveDamage@ magic damage and restore @MissingManaRatio@% missing Mana, increased to @ChampionMissingManaRatio@% against champions.
entries.spell_warwicke_tooltip: Warwick gains @DRAmount@% damage reduction for @DRDuration@ seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, <status>Fearing</status> nearby enemies for @FearDuration@ second. Warwick can <recast>Recast</recast> to end the Ability early.
entries.spell_dravenpassive_summary: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.
entries.spell_xinzhaor_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Deals a max of <physicalDamage>600 damage</physicalDamage> to jungle monsters and minions.</rules>
entries.spell_sivirr_summary: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.
entries.spell_twitchdeadlyvenommarker_tooltip:
Twitch's Attacks infect his target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing @DamagePerSecond@ true damage per second for @Duration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times.

Max Damage Per Second: @DamagePerSecondMax@
entries.spell_lulue_summary: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
entries.spell_twitchexpunge_tooltip:
Deals @BaseDamage@ physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional @PhysicalDamagePerStack@ physical damage and @MagicDamagePerStack@ magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom.

Max Damage: @MaxPhysicalDamage@ physical damage and @MaxMagicDamage@ magical damage.
entries.spell_velkozw_summary: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.
entries.spell_warwickq_summary: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.
entries.spell_velkoze_tooltip: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, <status>Knocking Up</status> for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be <status>Knocked Back</status> instead of <status>Knocked Up</status>.
entries.spell_zileanq_tooltip:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After @FuseDuration@ seconds it detonates, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for @StunDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_warwickp_tooltip:
Warwick's Attacks deal an additional @OnHitDamage@ magic damage On-Hit.

If Warwick is below @HealingThreshold*100@% Health, he also heals for @HealingRatio*100@% of the damage dealt by Eternal Hunger. If Warwick is below @EmpoweredHealingThreshold*100@% health, the healing is increased to @EmpoweredHealingRatio*100@% of the damage dealt.
entries.spell_trundlediseaseoverseer_summary: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.
entries.spell_twitchhideinshadows_summary:
Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.

When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.
entries.spell_nulllance_tooltip: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and interrupting channels. Kassadin also gains <shield>@TotalShield@ Magic Shield</shield> for 1.5 seconds.
entries.spell_sivirq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
The damage falloff resets upon beginning its return.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @CritRatio*100@% effectiveness.
Cast time scales down with Attack Speed
entries.spell_katarinaw_tooltip: Katarina tosses a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> into the air and gains <speed>@MovespeedAmount@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @MovespeedDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_karthuslaywastea1_summary: Karthus unleashes a delayed blast at a location, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Deals increased damage to isolated enemies.
entries.spell_sivirw_tooltip:
For the next @BuffDuration@ seconds, Sivir gains @RicochetAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing @BounceDamage@ physical damage each bounce for up to @MaxBounces@ bounces.

These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.
entries.spell_xinzhaow_tooltipextendedbelowline:
The thrust's damage is increased by up to @CritChanceAmp*100@% based on Xin Zhao's Critical Strike Chance.
Deals @MinionMod@% damage to minions.
Applies Lifesteal at 33% effectiveness on both attacks.
entries.spell_nocturnee_tooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains @TooltipFearMS*100@% Move Speed toward Feared enemies.

Active: Nocturne plants a nightmare tether into his target, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @LeashDuration@ seconds. If the tether remains unbroken, the target is Feared for @CCDuration@ second(s).
entries.spell_teemor_tooltip:
Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by @SlowAmount@% and deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @DebuffDuration@ seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration.

Traps last @MushroomDuration@ minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has @MaxAmmo@ charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).
entries.spell_fling_summary: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.
entries.spell_lulupassive_summary: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.
entries.spell_teemoe_summary: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.
entries.spell_olaffrenziedstrikes_summary: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.
entries.spell_velkozpassive_summary: Vel'Koz's abilities apply <keywordName>Organic Deconstruction</keywordName> to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.
entries.spell_warwickr_tooltip: Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his <speed>Move Speed</speed>, <status>Suppressing</status> the first champion he collides with while he channels for @RDuration@ seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing <magicDamage>@DamageCumulative@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Warwick <healing>heals for 100% of all damage dealt</healing> during the channel.
entries.spell_velkozqsplitactivate_tooltip: Reactivate to split the missile at a 90 degree angle.
entries.spell_teemow_tooltip:
Passive: Teemo gains @PassiveMoveSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last @PassiveCooldownOnDamageTaken@ seconds.

Active: Teemo sprints, gaining @ActiveMoveSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for @ActiveMoveSpeedBuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.game_character_passivesummary_olaf: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.
entries.spell_trundlepain_summary: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.
entries.spell_yoner_summary: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.
entries.spell_recklessstrike_tooltipextendedbelo: <rules>Cast time scales based on bonus Attack Speed.</rules>
entries.spell_olafaxethrowcast_tooltip:
Olaf throws an axe, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*100@% for up to @MaxSlowDuration@ seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose @ShredAmount*100@% Armor for @DebuffDuration@ seconds.

If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to @TooltipCDRefund@ seconds, or fully refunded if @TooltipCDRefund@ seconds has elapsed.
entries.spell_dravenq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Draven will drop any <keywordMajor>Spinning Axes</keywordMajor> if he does not attack for @DurationTOOLTIP@ seconds. Attacking a turret or structure will not cause Draven's <keywordMajor>Spinning Axes</keywordMajor> to richochet.</rules>
entries.spell_olafragnarok_tooltip:
Passive: Olaf gains @Resists@ Armor and @Resists@ Magic Resist.

Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for @Duration@ seconds. While active, Olaf gains @AD@ Attack Damage. Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by @DurationExtension@ seconds.

Additionally, Olaf gains @Haste*100@% Move Speed towards enemy champions for @HasteDuration@ second.
entries.spell_nocturneq_tooltip:
Nocturne throws a shadow blade, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and leaving a dusk trail for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemy champions hit also leave a trail.

While on the trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains @MoveSpeed@% Move Speed and @BonusTrailAD@ Attack Damage.
entries.spell_warwickq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects, and does not Critically Strike.
While clamped, Warwick is immune to displacement.
entries.spell_nocturner_summary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.
entries.spell_yoner_tooltip: Yone strikes all enemies along a path for <physicalDamage>@TooltipDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <magicDamage>@TooltipDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, teleporting behind the last champion hit and <status>Knocking Up</status> victims towards Yone.
entries.spell_twitchvenomcask_summary: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
entries.spell_zileanq_summary: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.
entries.spell_dravenfury_tooltipextendedbelowlin: <rules>Ghosted units can pass through other units.</rules>
entries.spell_dravenrdoublecast_tooltip: Cause Whirling Death to reverse direction early, returning to Draven.
entries.spell_nocturnew_summary: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.
entries.spell_twitchfullautomatic_tooltip: Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining @BonusRange@ Attack Range and @BonusAD@ Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for @Duration@ seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal @FallOffDamage*100@% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of @MinimumFallOffDamage*100@% damage.
entries.spell_trundletrollsmash_tooltipextendedb:
{{ buff_desc_SpellEffects }}
Trundle gains @BonusRange@ attack range for this attack.
entries.spell_luluw_tooltip:
When used on an ally, Lulu grants @TotalMS@ Move Speed and @ASBonus*100@% Attack Speed for @MSDuration@ seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for @CCDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_trundlepain_tooltipextendedbelowli:
Half of the damage and shred happen immediately and the other half happens over the duration.
The shred lasts for @DurationOfDrainForTooltip@ seconds after the drain ends.
entries.spell_xinzhaow_tooltip:
Xin Zhao slashes, dealing @SlashDamage@ physical damage, then thrusts, dealing @ThrustDamage@. Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by @Effect6Amount*-100@% for @TotalSlowDuration@ seconds.

Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for @MarkDuration@ seconds and revealed unless Stealthed.
entries.spell_katarinapassive_tooltip:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last @ResetWindow@ seconds, her Ability Cooldowns are reduced by @ResetCDR@ seconds.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.
entries.spell_teemoq_tooltip: Teemo fires a dart, <status>Blinding</status> the target for @BlindDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@CalculatedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_yonew_tooltip:
Yone cleaves forward, dealing @BaseDamage*0.5@ + @MaxHealthDamage*50@% max Health physical damage and @BaseDamage*0.5@ + @MaxHealthDamage*50@% max Health magic damage.

If Yone hits, he gains @WShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. The amount of Shield increases for each champion struck.
entries.spell_nocturner_tooltipsimple:
Enemies cannot see what other enemies see for @ParanoiaDuration@ second(s).

Re-activate during this to dash to and damage an enemy champion.
entries.spell_zileanq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>The bomb will prioritize attaching to champions and units that already have a bomb.</rules>
entries.spell_lulupassive_tooltip: Lulu is assisted by Pix the faerie. When Lulu Attacks, Pix fires 3 bolts at her target, dealing <magicDamage>@CombinedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the first enemy hit.
entries.spell_yonee_summary: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.
entries.spell_yonee_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Yone cannot snap back while affected by hard crowd control.</rules>
entries.spell_velkozpassive_tooltip:
Vel'Koz's Abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction for @Duration@ seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks consume them and take @TotalDamage@ true damage.

Vel'Koz's Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction, but won't add new stacks.
entries.spell_katarinar_summary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.
entries.spell_xinzhaop_tooltip: Every third Attack or strike with <spellName>Wind Becomes Lightning</spellName> deals an additional <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and restores <healing>@TotalHealing@ Health</healing>.
entries.spell_nocturner_tooltip: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for @ParanoiaDuration@ seconds. Nocturne can <recast>Recast</recast> this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing <physicalDamage>@Damage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
entries.spell_katarinar_tooltipextendedbelowline:
This Ability applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit and On-Attack effects at @OnHitRatio*100@% damage, and does not Critically Strike or apply Life Steal.
The physical damage additionally increases with Attack Speed.
